info.name: IronVault API
info.description:
IronVault – Gym Fitness Repository Management System.

Run the whole collection in order (Collection Runner or Newman). Set `baseUrl`, `adminIdentifier` and `adminPassword` in an environment first. Created data uses `@e2e.ironvault.test` emails and `E2E` tier names – remove it with `npm run test:cleanup` in /server.

exec: pm.test("password not returned", () => pm.expect(!('password' in body.data.user)).to.be.true);
pm.test("has membership section", () => pm.expect('membership' in body.data).to.be.true);

item.name: 3 · Memberships
item.description: Tiers and the membership lifecycle (state chart).

exec: pm.test("nested exercise errors", () => pm.expect('exercises.0.name' in body.errors).to.be.true);
pm.test("member list hidden", () => pm.expect(!('assignedMembers' in body.data)).to.be.true);
